title: Placencia 30-polygon coastal grid (high-res)
description: The 30-polygon high-resolution spatial framework used for Placencia's coastal model (reference/summary.md §2.2). Serves as the geometric base for the clade/depth-bin MIMES outputs joined via csv-polygon-join. Sourced from `Pl Map 1-13-26.shp` (30 features; `MIMES_ID` ∈ {1..30} matches the CSV `Polygon_ID` set exactly). Companion to `placencia-coast-polygons` (low-res 8-polygon variant); both are kept available so downstream features can pick the resolution appropriate to their context.
